entity: Top-4 traders' share of the short side in PJM Western Hub day-ahead off-peak futures on ICE, early 2026
what_we_add: The record framing: 69.7% Q1 average vs 47.4% in 2024 Q1, only ~5 points over 2014-15 highs
why: The CFTC COT record for 2026-03-10 states 71.8% for 4-or-less traders short, our exact peak-week number, and the 2024 report shows the low-40s base.
